tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /yi ge brgya pa'i gzungs chog dbang bskur dang bcas pa bzhugs so//

bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// rnal 'byor pa gang zhig dam tshig nyams chag sogs sbyang ba'i phyir yi ge brgya pa'i gzungs chog bya bar 'dod na/ yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su maṇ+ḍal dkar po zlum po tsan+dan dkar po'i chus byugs pa'i dbus su/ 'bru dkar po'i tshom bu gcig bkod pa'i steng du rin po che'i bum pa bgegs bskrad/ kha rgyan mgul chings dang bcas pa'i nang du srog chags med pa'i chu dang*/ sman dri bzang po dang snying po sogs gang 'dzom blug /nyer lnga ka de la mi dgos/ mdun du dkar gtor dang mchod pa bshams/ stan bde bar 'dug nas/ gzhi bdag dang bgegs la ba liṃ byin la bka' bsgo/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ skyabs sems dang yan lag bdun pa rgyas par byas/ 'dir bdag bum stabs cig tu bskyed pa dpal phag mo gru pas mdzad pa'i gzungs chog tu gsal por gsungs pa ltar/ rang nyid skad cig gis rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum du gyur| oṃ zhes brjod pas bum pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ yig ser po yongs su gyur pa las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba stong gsum tsam pa gcig gi nang du/ bcud rnams rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum dri bzang gi chu rdo rje sems dpa'i rdul phra rab dpag tu med pa'i rang bzhin can/ bum pa'i nang du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba'i steng du hūm̐ yig dkar po las rdo rje rtse lnga pa dkar po'i lte ba hūm̐ dkar pos mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ don gnyis byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang dang bum pa'i nang du rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po cod pan can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar 'dzin pa'i tshul gyis yum la 'khyud cing*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur brten pa/ zhabs sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i pang du rdo rje snye ma sngon mo g.yas gri gug gdengs shing*/

g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan cing ral pa rgyab tu nyil ba zhabs pad+ma'i skyil krung gis yab la 'khril ba/ de dag gi mtha' skor du yi ge brgya pa'i sngags phreng dkar po bdun rim gyis bskor ba/ lha dang sngags las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba dang dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs| oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra sa twa sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ nas/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa gnyis su med par gyur/ dbang gi lhar oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes bum pa'i chus dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rigs lngas dbu brgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur par bsam/ gong ltar mchod/ gtor ma byin rlabs spyi 'gro ltar byas la/ oṃ a kā ro'i sngags bdun gyis 'khor 'das tsam la bsngo/ rdor dril dang bcas/ rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che// rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa kun// rdo rje dang po kun tu bzang*// phyag 'tshal phyag na rdo rje la// bstod par 'os pa sogs kyis bstod/ gzung thag sne mo nas bzung la/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra satwa twe no pa/ tiṣ+ṭha dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shre yaṃḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra mā me muñca/ badz+ri bha wa ma hā sa ma ya satwa ā'aḥ zhes bzlas pas rang bzhin gyi gnas dang nyi shu rtsa bzhi nas/ yi ge kha dog dkar po char bzhin du bab nas bum nang gi lha'i thugs kar thim pas thugs rgyud bskul/

rang gi thugs ka'i zla ba'i dbus su hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros gzung thag la brgyud de phyung ba bum nang gi lha yab yum la phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi byung bas bum pa yongs su gang zhing*/ bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dam tshig nyams chag nyes ltung sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa dag par gyur par bsam zhing*/ thun bzhi sogs kyi nges pa byas nas mi tshig gis bar ma chod par bzla/ thun mtshams su mchod bstod dang gtor 'bul bya/ sdig sgrib dag pa'i mtshan ma rmi lam sogs su mthong na mchod bstod dang gtor ma 'bul/ bzod par gsol nas/ bum nang gi rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum snyoms 'jug gis bdud rtsir ltem gyis zhu zhing sngags phreng yang 'od du zhu ba bum chu dang ro gcig tu gyur par bsam/ rgyas pa ni 'og nas 'byung ba ltar dbang bdag 'jug tu blang*/ slob ma la bskur zhing khrus bya/ de tsam mi nus na bum chus bdag dang slob ma yon bdag sogs gang la dgos pa khrus byas pas sgrib gsum bag chags dang bcas pa sbyong zhing*/ khyad par dam tshig nyams chags su gyur pa thams cad sbyong ba'i thabs ches zab pa yin/ mthar bsngo smon shis brjod bya zhing las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// 'di dag ni dpal phag mo gru pa'i bka' 'bum gyi yi ge brgya pa'i gzungs chog nyid bcos slad med par ngag 'don khrigs su bris pa yin/ yang 'di'i dbang byed par 'dod na/ gzhan gong ltar la/ maṇ+ḍal gyi tshom bu rdor sems yab yum du bskyed nas spyan 'dren dbang bskur rgyas 'debs sogs bdag bum ltar bya/ bdag bum mdun bskyed gsum thun mong du mchod cing gtor 'bul dang bstod pa byas/ bzlas pa'ang gsum ga thun mong du byas/ bzlas pa'i tshe/ mdun bskyed rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od 'phros/

sems can thams cad kyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ rdo rje sems dpa'i skur gyur tshur 'dus so sor thim par bsam/ mthar bum pa gong ltar gzhug /las bum du bgegs mthar byed bskyed bzlas bya/ rang bdag 'jug blangs/ slob ma khrus byas gral la 'khod/ me tog bkram maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ dbang gi don du/ dga' chen khyod bdag gis gsol ba btab/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs gsum gyis rgyun bshags bya/ slob ma rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum du mngon rtogs ltar bskyed/ ye shes pa spyan drangs bstim/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra dang rdo rje rgya gram gyis brtan par bya/ dbang gi don du byang chub rdo rje sogs gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/ mdun bskyed rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs ka nas dbang gi lha rang 'dra ba spros pa'i phyag na bum pa dkar po byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams nas slob ma la dbang bskur bar mdzad par bsam| bum pa thogs nas/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs sngags bcas kyis slob ma la dbang bskur/ bum chu sbyin/ de ltar bum pas dbang bskur ba'i byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma gyen du 'khyil ba las rigs lngas dbu brgyan/ dbang lha slob ma la bstims pas/ lus kyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag /rdo rje sems dpa'i sku bsgom pa la dbang bar byas par bsam| gsung gi rjes gnang ni/ mdun bskyed rdo rje sems dpa'i mtha'i sngags phreng dang slob dpon rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum du gsal ba'i mtha'i sngags phreng las sngags phreng gnyis ka re re spros| slob ma rdor sems yab yum du gsal ba'i sngags phreng la thim pa dpon slob gnyis kas bsam nas/ yi ge brgya pa tshar gsum slob mas rjes zlos bya/ slar slob mas/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi| |bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// gsum brjod bla mas me tog dor zhing*/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol| |zhes dang*/

su pra tiṣ+ṭha brjod/ des gsung gi rjes su gnang ba thob/ ngag gi sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi snying po bzla la dbang bar bya ba yin/ thugs kyi rjes gnang ni/ mdun bskyed slob dpon rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi thugs ka nas dang po'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'od 'phro ba re re spros pa slob ma lhar gsal ba'i snying khar thim par bsam zhing*/ slob ma don gyi rdo rje sems dpa' la mnyam par bzhag /slob dpon gyis slob ma'i snying khar rdo rje rtse lnga pa bzhag nas yig brgya lan gsum brjod/ des thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba thob| yid kyi sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa dag /rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug tu bsgom pa la dbang bar byas/ me tog 'thor zhing shis pa brjod/ lha bsgom zhing sngags bzla ba'i phyir/ dam bca' ba'i lugs spyi 'gro ltar bya/ mthar/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang*/ deng nas brtsams te sogs slob mas rjes zlos bya/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ slob dpon gyis mdun bskyed la mchod bstod bzod gsol bya zhing gshegs su gsol/ shis brjod bsngo smon bya zhing las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// de ltar rdo rje sems dpa'i gzungs chog rjes gnang dang bcas pa 'di'ang mnga' ris lha mo dkon mchog lhun grub kyis bskul ngor/ 'bri gung pa pad+ma badz+ra rtsal gyis bris pas sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib byang nas rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang dam pa thob par gyur cig/ //maṅga laṃ//
